transcript:
**Customer:** Hi, I’ve been having issues with my billing. I was charged twice this month for my Pro plan.

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that, and I can definitely help you with this. Can you please provide me with your account email so I can look into your billing history?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s john.smith@example.com. I noticed the charges when I checked my bank statement.

**Agent:** Thank you, John. Give me a moment to pull up your account... Okay, I see the double charge. It seems there was an error during our billing cycle. 

**Customer:** That's frustrating. I rely on your service for my business, and it’s concerning to see these kinds of mistakes.

**Agent:** I completely understand, and I apologize for the inconvenience. I can initiate a refund for the extra charge right away. Would you like me to do that?

**Customer:** Yes, please. And how long will it take for the refund to process?

**Agent:** Typically, it takes 3-5 business days to reflect in your account. I’ll ensure it’s prioritized on our end. 

**Customer:** Okay, thanks for that. Is there any way I can get alerts if there are any issues with billing in the future?

**Agent:** We can set up billing notifications through your account settings. Would you like me to send you a walkthrough on how to enable those?

**Customer:** That would be great, thank you. I just want to avoid surprises moving forward.

**Agent:** Absolutely, I’ll send over those instructions to your email shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

**Customer:** No, that covers everything. Thank you for your help!

**Agent:** You’re very welcome, John! I appreciate your patience. Have a great day!
